svg.title: Coffee package: remove an ornamental seal and border
svg.desc: Only the ROASTED WITH CARE seal and fine rectangular border are deleted. Product identity, tasting note, roast, weight, qualification, photograph/crop, typography, positions, label, pouch and light stay identical. Fictional front-label teaching mockup, not a complete production package.
